name: Shade Structure
description: Install shade structures (pergolas, canopies, or shade sails) over key outdoor areas such as entrances, courtyards, and play areas to reduce direct solar exposure.
notes: Prototype planning value. Actual cost depends on materials, area covered, and local labour rates.

name: Drinking Water Station
description: Install a dedicated drinking water station with chilled or ambient water access to support hydration during peak heat hours.
notes: Prototype planning value. Actual cost depends on plumbing availability and unit specification.

name: Ventilation Improvement
description: Upgrade ventilation through installation of ceiling fans, cross-ventilation openings, or exhaust systems to improve internal airflow and reduce heat build-up.
notes: Prototype planning value. Actual cost depends on building layout and existing HVAC infrastructure.

name: Green Coverage
description: Increase vegetative coverage through tree planting, vertical gardens, or ground-level landscaping to reduce ambient temperature through evapotranspiration.
notes: Prototype planning value. Full cooling benefit realised over multiple seasons as vegetation matures.

name: Reflective Roof Treatment
description: Apply cool-roof coating or install reflective roofing material to reduce solar heat absorption and lower indoor temperature.
notes: Prototype planning value. Effectiveness depends on roof area, existing material, and coating type.

name: Heat Relief Room
description: Establish a dedicated air-conditioned or fan-cooled relief space where occupants can recover from heat exposure during peak temperature hours.
notes: Prototype planning value. Highest-impact single intervention. Ongoing electricity costs apply.
